image_description: A close-up, studio-style shot of a black, rectangular disposable lighter against a plain white background. The lighter is oriented vertically. It features a smooth, matte or semi-gloss black plastic body with rounded corners. At the top right, a small black plastic ignition lever/windguard assembly is visible. A thin vertical highlight runs down the left side, indicating a light source. No flame is present.

The ignition lever and windguard area lacks clear mechanical definition. The parts seem to fuse together slightly without distinct gaps or shadows that would indicate separate moving components. The geometry is vague compared to real-world precision molding.
